description:
Based on the following evidences, the name “Amonus” is the author of  the SiriusQT RAT (which the following evidence is referring to): 

 

 

The name “Amonus”, is also contained in two PDB references consistent with a Windows development environment: 

 

C:\Users\Rasul\source\repos\Amonus\Sirius-QT\dotnet_loader\obj\Release\NetLoader32.pdb

C:\Users\Rasul\source\repos\Amonus\Sirius-QT\dotnet_loader\obj\Release\NetLoader64.pdb

Observed

  • Author (or co-author) of the SiriusQT RAT, based on the name "Amonus" in the PDB paths of the .NET loader (NetLoader32.pdb, NetLoader64.pdb).

  • Develops on Windows with Visual Studio under the local username "Rasul".

  • Builds in Release configuration, with separate 32-bit and 64-bit loader variants.

Assessed

  • Primarily a malware developer

  • Uses a loader + payload architecture

  • "Amonus" may be an individual or a team, and "Rasul" one of its members (low confidence).
